card.title: 392nd RIFLES
card.text: Give units you deploy +2 attack and deal them 1 damage. Becomes Veteran when it has dealt 4+ damage.
card.flavorText: The 392nd Rifle Regiment was a unit of the 73rd Rifle Division of the Soviet Red Army. The division was initially formed in the Siberian Military District in 1930. At the start of the German invasion into the Soviet Union, the division was assigned to the 20th Army and suffered heavy losses during the early German offensives. It was reformed but again devastated during the Battle of Moscow in 1941. Despite this setback, the 73rd Rifle Division was rebuilt yet again. This time, it participated in the capture of the city of Voronezh during the Voronezh-Kastornoye offensive, and later in the Soviet counteroffensives that followed the Battle of Kursk. The division continued fighting through the war, distinguishing itself in operations such as the crossing of the Dnieper River, and played a role in offensives across Ukraine and into Poland. It ended the war on the Baltic Coast.
